target_surface: Ampere scanner transient Bol read recovery and paused-state truth
problem: One transient production /api/retailer failure aborts a complete snapshot and the blocked UI still claims the scanner is ready.

edges.evidence: Failed external verification is mapped to retailer 503
refreshSnapshot sets phase=error and render disables scanning
retry and malformed-payload tests prove the boundary
Only the deployed artifact changes warehouse behavior

order_1: bounded transient retries at the server request boundary
order_3: operator trust improves because ready/paused language matches actual input availability
future changes remain constrained by recovery and exhaustion tests
feedback_loops: A retryable failure consumes a bounded attempt; success completes the atomic snapshot, while exhaustion returns the existing fail-closed pause.

verification_edges.verification: Vercel logs plus focused unit tests
desktop/mobile paused and ready screenshots plus interface contract
exact deployment identity and post-deploy logs/browser check

decision: Use bounded server retries for transient external failures only, preserve all fail-closed validators, and make the browser's blocked state internally consistent.
